book.name: 1 KOLINITA
book.title: ME KOLINITA ꞌIDI LETA ꞌEBWEUNA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: Bwagobwago mali ꞌebe emisao ꞌediya

Gosegwao tubudao wada nuwaꞌiꞌisidi ꞌaene lowaenei tuta nina sena mwatui daitaya sitautauya, ta pwana ꞌenega Yaubada ꞌianuganedi, ga wate ola solanaya ꞌidi ꞌeda ꞌiguinuwena ga ꞌenega siabala mali esenaya.
ꞌEnega pwana be ola ꞌediyega ꞌidi bapitaiso silobena ꞌaene Mosese ꞌana tomuliyao,
ta wate ꞌadi masula be ꞌadi bwasi maiboꞌana galewega silobena yaluyaluwadi manuna, ta ꞌadi bwasi siꞌewaꞌewa gulewa ꞌebweu ꞌenega, ta gulewa nina galewega maꞌedi sitautauya, ꞌana esana Keliso.
Ta esi Yaubada nigeya ꞌigwaugwausowala tubudao nidi manudi, ꞌenega mitawa nina ꞌenaya yaudi simwawasa, ga kokowadi nada siebesinedi.
Ta taudi ꞌebeꞌita ꞌedaya be ꞌaene geyaꞌabo toꞌumalina manuna tanuwanuwa,

ta wate geyaꞌabo tabwagobwago mali ꞌebe emisao ꞌediya, nadigega taudi mitawaya siguinuwena. Buki Tabu ꞌena taudi manudi ꞌisimana, ꞌigwae, “Tomota nidi simiyatowa ga siꞌeꞌai ta sinumanuma, ga muliyega sitoolo ga siguinuwa besobeso.”
Ta wate siloeloelata, ꞌenega ꞌasiyata ꞌebweuna ꞌenaya site tuweniti tili tausani ꞌediyega Yaubada ꞌiloemwawasidi. Gete ꞌebeꞌita ꞌedaya be ꞌaene geyaꞌabo taloeloelata.
Ta wate Yaubada ꞌana ꞌoataꞌoata sisaꞌuna ga mwata ꞌenega ꞌiloemwawasidi. Getei ꞌieꞌiteda ꞌaene geyaꞌabo ꞌaboꞌada wate nadigega taguiguinuwaꞌesa.
Ta wate Yaubada silomugiyena, ga ꞌenega ꞌebweu anilose ꞌietunenama ga ꞌigietoꞌumaliyedi ꞌidi lomugi nidi manuna. ꞌEbeꞌita gete ꞌedaya be ꞌaene geyaꞌabo talomulomugi.
ꞌEbeꞌita nidi getedi maiboꞌadi Buki Tabu ꞌena siꞌetoladidi be ꞌaene gete tuga ꞌaboꞌada ꞌepata auwauda eꞌisa nidi mwaudi tada nuwaꞌiꞌisidi, be geyaꞌabo loegesi nidi taguiguinuwedi.
ꞌEnega ꞌabo yaita ꞌoyo ꞌunuwena ꞌaene ma imu waiwai ꞌutootoolo, ꞌuda ꞌitaꞌiꞌisiyo be geyaꞌabo ꞌuneeneta,

manuna ꞌebe toona nidi ꞌediyega Seitani ꞌitootoomi, maiboꞌada wate ꞌitootooda nadigega, ta esi Yaubada ꞌina loina ꞌisaꞌuna be geyaꞌabo Seitani ꞌitootoo wawasaeda, ta ꞌabo taꞌalamaꞌiꞌita ꞌiabe ꞌeda boboꞌana ꞌieꞌitada be ꞌenega ꞌebe toona nidi taewaiwai sinedi.
Gosegwao, nuwanuwagu sinabwana be mali ꞌebe emisao waguitoyasedi.
ꞌOmi ma imi mwalatoi, ꞌenega ꞌigu ona gete manuna wada nuwanuwa sinabwana.

Manuna ꞌeguma sakalameni manuna talokagutoki Yaubada ꞌenaya be tanunuma, nate Keliso lalanega ꞌigieboboꞌaneda be Keliso maꞌeda taeꞌebweuna. Nadigega beledi, ꞌabo tagitomwa be taꞌaꞌani, beledi nina ꞌenega Keliso maꞌeda taeꞌebweuna, manuna tauna oona taeꞌani.
Beledi nina ꞌebweuna ꞌenega maiboꞌada taꞌeꞌai, ꞌenega Keliso oona ꞌenaya taeboda ꞌebweuna.
Nadigega tuga me Isileli yauyaudi ꞌidi taliyao siunudi Yaubada manuna ga siꞌenidi, ꞌenega Yaubada maꞌedi sieboda ꞌebweuna.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, masula nidi taudi tomiya apwesa siꞌebwaꞌebwaya mali ꞌebe emisao ꞌediya, ta wate ꞌidi ꞌebe emisao nidi, nai kaiwe nai gulewa, yage besobeso tuga, ta nigeya ꞌidi waiwaimo.

Ta wate guinuwa nidi taudi tomiya apwesa yage nidi manudi siguiguinuwa, nigeya Yaubada manuna sinuwanuwa, ta esi Taumudumudulele magosenao manudi. ꞌEnega geya nuwagu be mali ꞌebe emisao manudi waguiguinuwa, ꞌabona nai Taumudumudulele gosenao maꞌemiyao waeboda ꞌebweuna.
Nigeya ꞌana ꞌita boboꞌana ꞌeguma ꞌInapwana ꞌana keiga ꞌenega wanumanuma be ꞌina ꞌebe ꞌeꞌai ꞌenega waꞌeꞌai ta wate Taumudumudulele ꞌina guinuwa waguiguinuwedi,
manuna ꞌInapwana ꞌatena wagiegie dededoni. ꞌInapwana nina Toewaiwai sana, ꞌenega geyaꞌabo tagiegie gamwasowali, ꞌabona nai ꞌipeꞌuda.
Masula nidi mali ꞌebe emisao manudi.
Yage maiboꞌadi sawesawedaya be taguinuwedi, ta ꞌaina yage geyaꞌabo silemelemeda.
ꞌEnega ꞌilobweneda be guinuwa nidi taguinuwedi gosedao ꞌadi lema manuna, ta esi geyaꞌabo ꞌaboꞌada tauda ꞌada lema manuna.
ꞌEnega ꞌabo yobai esiyona mali tomota ꞌediyega wagimwane, geyaꞌabo waenaenaida esiyo nina manuna, ta esi wada ꞌani tuga, be geyaꞌabo wanuwanuwa toꞌumalina toꞌase lowa masula nina ꞌena siguinuwena.
Manuna baleꞌu maiboꞌana ta wate yage maiboꞌana baleꞌuya Yaubada ꞌina ꞌebe loinao.

Ta ꞌabo tomiya apwesa ꞌebweu ꞌibwauyeyo be ꞌutatauya ꞌina anuwaya be ꞌamu masula ꞌisaꞌu manuyo, tuga ꞌuꞌaꞌani, ta geyaꞌabo ꞌuenaida toꞌase lowa ꞌiguinuwena masula nina ꞌenaya, be ꞌenega geyaꞌabo wanuwanuwa mwau manuna.

Ta esi ꞌabo yaita ꞌisimana masula nina manuna be ꞌemiya ꞌigwae, “Taudi ꞌidi guinuwa Taumudumudulele manuna masula nate ꞌenega siguinuwena,” geyaꞌabo masula nina ꞌuꞌeꞌani, ꞌabona nai tauna tosimana nina ꞌinuwamwau, nai ꞌimatauta, ꞌenega ꞌoyo wate ꞌuda nuwamwau,

nigeya tauyo ꞌimu matauta ꞌenega, manuna ꞌoyo nigeya Taumudumudulele ꞌumatamataute, ta esi tosimana nina ꞌina matautega. Ta ꞌaina tomota sigwae, “Geyaꞌabo ꞌagu loina wasaꞌusaꞌu taudi toneneta ꞌidi nuwanuwa manuna,
ta wate geyaꞌabo taudi silomulomugiyegu. ꞌAgu masula nina manuna niꞌatu yalokagutoki Yaubada ꞌenaya, ta nigeya ꞌebweu wate ꞌana toꞌumalina ꞌeguya ꞌimiyami.”
Taudi ꞌidi ona ꞌana eꞌisa gete, ꞌaene ꞌilobweneda be ꞌida guinuwa maiboꞌana, nai ꞌida ꞌeꞌai, nai ꞌida numa, nai toꞌase wate, ꞌediyega Yaubada ꞌana esana tagie sinabwa.
ꞌEnega geyaꞌabo mali tomota wagiegie nuwamwauyedi, nai me Yudia, nai taudi nigeya me Yudia, nai Yaubada ꞌina toekalesiyao,

nadigega ꞌaboꞌagu yatootoo be ꞌaene geyaꞌabo taugu ꞌigu nuwenuwega yaguiguinuwa, ta esi toꞌase tomota ꞌidi nuwanuwa nadigega yada guinuwe tuga, be sida gwausowala, be ꞌenega ꞌadi ꞌetoseyana sida loba Yaubada ꞌenega.
